rv.q: BoHo Theatre tells the semi-autobiographical story of tick, tick... BOOM! with great care and explosive energy.
BoHo Theatre’s tick, tick…BOOM! accomplishes all it sets out to do and more, staying ever-true to the company’s vision...
Sometimes, an inspiration just works perfectly.
If you like high-energy, metaphysical ponderings and a rockin' soundtrack, then get ready to be blown away!
Fans of Jonathan Larson’s work will absolutely enjoy seeing this seldom-produced musical, now ticking away and booming with vitality at BoHo Theatre.

They all play their characters with a lot of energy to paint these scenes for us, however there were moments, at least for this writer ,that didn't sound quite in harmony when the three were together.
But there is a degree of acting chemistry missing among the cast.
But some of the songs are truly moving (“Real Life”) and others witty, and all get their due and then some from the cast and band under music director Harper Caruso.
Bo-Ho Theatre's production is one that will knock your sox off.
